主要内容: On March 8, 2021, Nicholas Financial, Inc. announced the establishment of a new branch office in Salt Lake City, Utah. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, details the expansion, which marks a strategic move to enhance its regional presence. The company is registered with the NASDAQ under the ticker symbol NICK. This event is reported under Item 8.01 of the Form 8-K filing, indicating it is not deemed "filed" for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The expansion is a company-specific development and does not include any market-wide implications or financial statement disclosures at this time.
